marks.gloss_en: ומי ילפינן מינה? והתניא: זהו היתר הבא מכלל איסור -- זהו למעוטי מאי? לאו למעוטי כל איסורין שבתורה
the baraita: 'this is a permission that comes out of a prohibition' -- [the Gemara: 'this' excludes what? does it not exclude all the Torah's prohibitions?]
לא נצרכא אלא לרבי יהודה ... קא משמע לן דהכא בטיל (= p_abaye_zehu_lerabbi_yehuda)
Abaye: [זהו] is needed only for R' Yehuda, who says a kind in its own kind is not nullified -- it teaches that here it is nullified
לא נצרכה אלא לטעם כעיקר ... קא משמע לן דהכא שרי (= p_rava_zehu_taam_kikar)
Rava: [זהו] is needed only for flavour-as-substance, which in sacrifices forbids -- it teaches that here it is permitted
וליגמר מיניה? -- let R' Yehuda learn from the foreleg that a kind in its kind is nullified
גלי רחמנא: ולקח מדם הפר ומדם השעיר -- together and not nullified (= p_dam_par_vesair)
the Merciful One revealed: 'and he shall take of the blood of the bull and of the blood of the goat' (Lev 16:18) -- the two are together and are not nullified
ומאי חזית דגמרינן מהאיך, ליגמר מהאי? -- why learn from the bloods rather than from the foreleg?
חידוש הוא, ומחידוש לא גמרינן (= p_zroa_chidush)
[the cooked foreleg] is a novelty, and from a novelty we do not learn
אי הכי, למאה וששים נמי לא ליגמר? -- if the foreleg is a novelty, the sixty and the hundred cannot be learned from it either
אטו אנן לקולא גמרינן? לחומרא גמרינן, דמדאורייתא ברובא בטיל (= p_lechumra_gamrinan)
do we learn [sixty or a hundred] to leniency? we learn it to stringency, for by Torah law it is nullified in a majority
the baraita: 'beshela' means only whole
[first account] all agree it is cooked with the ram; one holds it is cut off and then cooked, the other that it is cooked and then cut off
[second account] all agree it is cut off and then cooked; but one holds it is cooked with the ram, the other in another pot
on the first account, [the derivation from the foreleg holds] according to all
the one who says sixty holds that we measure meat and bones against meat and bones, and it comes to sixty
